text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To her surprise, Maruzensky invited Sakura 
Chiyono O to a mock race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined not to lose to her idol, she 
gathers race materials. However, a story 
from Mr. C.B. causes a certain doubt to 
take root within her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And in the middle of running, doubt turned 
into certainty. —This person has never 
once run with all their might, burning 
with the thought of "I don't want to 
lose."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was also proof that right now, she was 
not recognized as her rival. Refusing to 
accept this, Sakura Chiyono O fired 
herself up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"To the hesitating Maruzensky, she vowed, 
'I'll definitely light a fire in your 
heart,' pledging to take on the Autumn 
Tenno Sho alongside the Senior class."
